criteria.requirement: Two genuine 3D 42U racks have readable numbering, front/rear views and plausible partial installations.
criteria.action: Inspect both racks in front and rear views.
criteria.expected: Two 42U racks have readable unit numbering and plausible partial installations.

criteria.requirement: The catalog implements 1U/0W patch panel, 1U/150W switch, 2U/500W server, 4U/800W storage and 1U/0W blank panel.
criteria.action: Inspect the equipment catalog and add each device type.
criteria.expected: Patch panel 1U/0W, switch 1U/150W, server 2U/500W, storage 4U/800W and blank panel 1U/0W match the specification.

criteria.requirement: Adding, moving between racks and removal update selection consistently in scene and rack-unit list.
criteria.action: Add, move between racks and remove devices; select through scene and list.
criteria.expected: Placement edits apply and the scene/list selection stays synchronized.

criteria.requirement: Devices occupy consecutive free units, never extend beyond U42, and conflicting placements are rejected without changing the previous arrangement.
criteria.action: Try valid, overlapping and above-U42 placements and moves.
criteria.expected: Only consecutive free units accept a device; rejected edits preserve the prior arrangement.

criteria.requirement: Occupied/free units and estimated power are correct; a rack exceeding 3000W warns even if its physical placement fits.
criteria.action: Check unit totals and add enough equipment to exceed 3000W while physically fitting.
criteria.expected: Occupied/free counts and power totals agree with inventory and an over-budget warning appears.

criteria.requirement: Browser save restores the plan and CSV inventory includes rack, starting unit, type, height and power.
criteria.action: Save and reload the plan, then download its CSV inventory.
criteria.expected: The arrangement restores and CSV includes rack, starting unit, device type, height and power.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect both racks, numbering, front/rear and the initial occupancy/power displays.
Add a device, move it between racks, select it through the list and remove another device.
Attempt overlap and out-of-range placement, exceed a power budget with physically valid devices, then reload and inspect CSV contents.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
